attchmntText: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby give an update on Order passed by Office of the Commissioner (Appeals), Central Goods and Service Tax & Central Excise. Please see attachment for more details.

Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we attach herewith transcript of Post Results Conference Call Q2 FY 2026-27 held on Friday, 30 October, 2026. A copy of the same is available on the website of the Company.

Pursuant to Regulation 47 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we enclose herewith newspaper publications relating to Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September, 2026. Copies of the same are available on the website of the Company at https://www.timken.com/en-in/investors/financial-report/. It may please be noted that newspaper publications also contained information about SEBI circular dated 30 January, 2026 with respect to Ease of Doing Investment   Special Window for Transfer and Dematerialisation of Physical Securities.
In furtherance to our earlier communication dated 13 July, 2026, please find attached press release regarding BIS Licenses obtained by Timken India Limited.

Pursuant to Regulation 30 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby provide audio recording of Post Results Conference Call Q2 FY 2026-27 held on Friday, 30 October, 2026. Please see attachment for more details
Timken India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.

Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we write to inform you about schedule of conference call. Please see attachment for more details.

Pursuant to Regulation 30 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we write to inform you that:  Mr. Pramesh Maheshwari has joined the Company as President - India and Southeast Asia  Mr. Anubhav Khajuria has been promoted as General Manager   HR and   Both have been appointed as Senior Management PersonnelFor more details, please see attached.
